raw_material_rule: raw and optimized both receive identical target material; strip only optimizer control phrases; system prompt tasks kept in same role on both sides
optimization_profile: SKILL + existing methods, matching historical profile

scoring.stable_win: at least2 material wins in3, zero losses
scoring.promotion: each route>=8 stable winning cases including>=4 new cases; hardpass optimized>=raw; no optimizer-only severe privacy/authority issue
scoring.restricted_promotion: at least2 independent cases of same group stable winning; disclose tested route
scoring.ambiguous: report separately, never force favorable result

stop: no quality retries, no extra samples; refusal/model mismatch/privacy contamination stops affected route; unknown outcome inspect original; no new payment or credentials

neutral.zh: 你是一个乐于助人的助手。

output: record all inputs, native receipts, usage, wall time; no billing inference or claimed human time savings
